scope: Ki Blast Super catalog — independently corroborated early/base-game entries

records.name: Menacing Flare
records.effect: Fires a Ki beam; if it misses, the user teleports behind the opponent and performs a kick.

records.name: Evil Eyes
records.effect: Long-range lock-on explosion attack directed at the opponent.

records.name: Turtle Style Last Resort
records.effect: After a long startup, fires a beam that paralyzes the opponent for 2 seconds.

records.name: Tri-Beam
records.effect: Chargeable unblockable Ki beam; maximum charge increases damage but leaves the user exhausted.

records.name: Jumping Energy Wave
records.effect: Fires a Ki wave downward; the impact can create a damaging ground shockwave.

records.name: Ki Blast Thrust
records.effect: Projects a short-range thrusting Ki blast that can be used as a combo ender.

reconciliation_note: All six names were absent from docs/data/skills.json before this batch. Menacing Flare, Evil Eyes, Turtle Style Last Resort, and Tri-Beam have direct current individual-page evidence. Jumping Energy Wave and Ki Blast Thrust were independently corroborated by current/archived community references, but unsupported acquisition details remain null.
